<translated_code>
n, m, k, c, d = map(int, input().split())
Z = 100
N = Z * Z

px = [0] * N
py = [0] * N
head = [-1] * N
to = [0] * (3 * N * 100)
cap = [0] * (3 * N * 100)
cost = [0] * (3 * N * 100)
nxt = [0] * (3 * N * 100)
tot = 0

def add_edge(u, v, f, cst):
    global tot
    to[tot] = v
    cap[tot] = f
    cost[tot] = cst
    nxt[tot] = head[u]
    head[u] = tot
    tot += 1
    to[tot] = u
    cap[tot] = 0
    cost[tot] = -cst
    nxt[tot] = head[v]
    head[v] = tot
    tot += 1

s = 0
t = n * 100 + 1

for i in range(1, 101):
    add_edge(i, t, 100, 0)

for _ in range(k):
    v = int(input())
    add_edge(s, (v - 1) * 100 + 1, 1, 0)

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(1, 100):
        add_edge((i - 1) * 100 + j, (i - 1) * 100 + j + 1, 100, c)

for _ in range(m):
    u, v = map(int, input().split())
    for j in range(1, 100):
        idx = (u - 1) * 100 + j
        idy = (v - 1) * 100 + j + 1
        for k in range(1, 51):
            add_edge(idx, idy, 1, c + (k * k - (k - 1) * (k - 1)) * d)
    for j in range(1, 100):
        idx = (v - 1) * 100 + j
        idy = (u - 1) * 100 + j + 1
        for k in range(1, 51):
            add_edge(idx, idy, 1, c + (k * k - (k - 1) * (k - 1)) * d)

import math
total_flow = 0
total_cost = 0

while True:
    dist = [math.inf] * (N + 2)
    parent = [-1] * (N + 2)
    parent_edge = [-1] * (N + 2)
    dist[s] = 0
    q = [s]
    head_q = 0
    while head_q < len(q):
        u = q[head_q]
        head_q += 1
        i = head[u]
        while i != -1:
            if cap[i] > 0 and dist[to[i]] > dist[u] + cost[i]:
                dist[to[i]] = dist[u] + cost[i]
                parent[to[i]] = u
                parent_edge[to[i]] = i
                q.append(to[i])
            i = nxt[i]
    if dist[t] == math.inf:
        break
    f = math.inf
    u = t
    while u != s:
        f = min(f, cap[parent_edge[u]])
        u = parent[u]
    u = t
    while u != s:
        cap[parent_edge[u]] -= f
        rev = parent_edge[u] ^ 1
        cap[rev] += f
        u = parent[u]
    total_cost += dist[t] * f
    total_flow += f

print(total_cost)
